report_name: US Cybersecurity Information Sharing Law Faces December Expiration

identities.name: U.S. Congress
identities.description: The U.S. legislative body responsible for renewing, modifying, or letting the Cybersecurity Information Sharing Act of 2015 expire by its December 11, 2026 deadline.

identities.name: Department of Homeland Security
identities.description: The U.S. federal department that manages the information sharing hub for 'cyber threat indicators' and 'defensive measures' under the Cybersecurity Information Sharing Act of 2015.
